description: Ashby is a recruiting and talent acquisition platform that combines applicant tracking, recruiting CRM, scheduling, automation, analytics, and AI features. It also offers a standalone recruiting analytics product for teams that keep an existing ATS.
summary: Ashby exposes a Basic-authenticated public HTTP API at `api.ashbyhq.com`, a public unauthenticated job postings HTTP API, and an OAuth-protected remote MCP server at `mcp.ashbyhq.com/mcp/v1`.
